subject: Hosted API pricing — request to align with competitor effective rate
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novusai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@novusai.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing — need to reconcile vs Anthropic/OpenAI

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. We ran a quick cost exercise and NovusAI's economics are tight — our engineering team projects ~30M tokens/month on average with bursts to ~80M. To move forward we need an econ that meaningfully displaces our current plan with Anthropic. They quoted an effective rate of ~$0.00022/token (6-month commit) for the mix of chat + embeddings we run.

Two asks from procurement:
- Can Redwood provide a committed usage structure (monthly tokens, 12 months) with a step-down per-token rate?
- Will you entertain a short-term trial/price-match option for the first 3 months so we can validate latency/quality and then convert to a longer commit?

We also need SOC 2 evidence and basic IP/data residency answers (we'll attach an RFP soon).

Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Ops | NovusAI

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novusai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need to reconcile vs Anthropic/OpenAI

Hi Olivia — appreciate the clear ask and the numbers. Quick reply with a pragmatic commercial we think will address displacement and give NovusAI runway to validate:

Proposal (high level):
- 12-month commit: 30M tokens/month (baseline) with burst capacity to 80M for the first 3 months.
- Pricing: base (no commit) public rate: $0.00045/token.
- Commit tier pricing (effective per-token):
  * 30M/mo commit: $0.00030/token (33% off public rate)
  * 50M/mo commit: $0.00026/token (42% off public rate)
  * 80M/mo commit: $0.00022/token (51% off public rate)
- First 3 months: pilot price-match clause — if you can provide the Anthropic quote, we'll match the effective per-token rate (up to the 50M tier) for months 1–3 subject to a one-time validation cap of 100M tokens across the three months.
- Overage: charged at the next-tier committed rate (e.g., if you commit 30M and go to 40M, overage at 50M-tier price).
- Additional value: we will include a one-time optimization engagement (Aditya will lead) to configure batching/caching and reduce your per-token consumption by an expected 8–15% depending on prompt patterns.

We can put a short-term NDAs/POC and include SOC2 report and the private deployment checklist in the SOW. Attached is a draft offer doc with line-item math. If these economics look directionally right we can spin a DocuSign and a 7–10 day signature SLA so Novus can get the pilot running.

cc: Laura to help with legal/SOW and Aditya for the technical optimization scope.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: redwood-commit-offer-novusai-20260601.pdf (proposal)

From: procurement@novusai.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novusai.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need to reconcile vs Anthropic/OpenAI

Karthik,

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few clarifying items from procurement/legal: 
- Can you put the pilot price-match clause in writing and confirm what qualifies as "effective per-token rate" (e.g., are embeddings and chat weighted differently)?
- We prefer a 6-month trial match vs 3 months to reduce churn risk. Would Redwood consider matching for months 1–6 if we commit to a 12-month contract thereafter?
- Any credits/penalties if Redwood fails to meet latency SLOs during the pilot?

Also, happy to share Anthropic's quote under an NDA — what's the best way to send it?

Procurement
NovusAI

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: procurement@novusai.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need to reconcile vs Anthropic/OpenAI

Hi Novus procurement team — happy to confirm and put concrete language in the offer doc. Proposed updates: 
- "Effective per-token rate" definition: blended cost across the usage mix in the first month of pilot (chat tokens weighted 1.0, embeddings weighted 0.6 to reflect lower compute) — we will calculate on tokens consumed and provide the calculation workbook in the SOW.
- Pilot extension: Redwood can extend the match to 6 months if Novus signs the 12-month commit within 30 days of pilot start. Match capped at the 50M-tier price for months 1–6 and subject to a validation cap (200M tokens total for the six months).
- Latency SLO: If median p95 latency exceeds committed SLO by more than 25% for a full rolling week, customer receives a 10% credit on that week's token consumption (pilot only).
- Delivery: We'll accept Anthropic quote over secure Share (sftp or DocuSign secure upload).

I'll update the PDF and SOW and route to DocuSign; Aditya will produce the optimization scope.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@novusai.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — need to reconcile vs Anthropic/OpenAI

Karthik/Laura/Aditya — thanks, this is helpful and answers most of our questions. A couple quick items before I route to legal for sign-off: 
- Novus accepts the 6-month match window (months 1–6) capped at the 50M-tier price, and we agree to the 12-month committed conversion trigger.
- Please add a one-line data residency clause confirming tokens and logs for this tenant remain in the US region.
- Send the DocuSign link and we will aim to sign by EOD Friday once legal reviews the SOW.

I'll upload Anthropic's quote to the secure link Laura provides.

Olivia
Head of Platform Ops | NovusAI
